description: Published RFC 8037 Appendix A.1 Ed25519 test key (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8037#appendix-A.1). This is the same key material as RFC 8032 section 7.1 TEST 1, reused verbatim as stated in RFC 8037's own Appendix A intro. This is PUBLIC test-vector material only -- it MUST NEVER be trusted or used outside Stint's own conformance vectors.
